allowances.rationale: The CLI adds a request-bound audit object; its completeness status is validated against the native envelope and the complete object is still walked.
The CLI serializes the same native failure plus a request-bound pagination audit; error identity and the full remaining envelope must stay equal.
Plan owns a node/result envelope, but the complete native operation envelope must remain at this exact pointer.
Plan moves a native failure into the node error slot; the complete ErrorDetail and derived exit code must remain equal.
The MCP gravity.execute contract accepts registered Journey IDs and explicitly rejects raw operation IDs.

baseline_policy: allowed finding and scope-exclusion identities may only be removed; legal differences require an exact reason-coded allowance
